name: push-tag-human-approved-correction
body: Push and tag are human-approved acts. Only the optional `release-agent` carries a `git push`/`git tag` grant, and that grant is `ask`; every other generated agent carries zero push/tag grant (deny-by-default). The navigator captures explicit user consent before dispatching the release-agent. `requirements.requirement.push-tag-human-approved-release-only` is contained by `requirements.stakeholder.agent-suite-maintainer`, drives `domain.entity.release-agent-flow`, and its law surfaces are `requirements.constraint.push-tag-release-agent-carve-out`, `requirements.constraint.agent-changes-always-on-main`, and `solution.constraint.agent-builder-roster-truthful`. `domain.entity.release-agent-flow` is realised by `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` (`opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`), `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` (`opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`), `solution.component.agent-roster-docs` (`AGENTS.md` + `README.md`), and `solution.component.push-tag-policy-surfaces` (implemented by `Cargo.toml`, `src/git/mod.rs`, `src/project_cmd/mod.rs`, `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.plan_verify_at`, `tests/git_e2e.rs`, `tests/project_cmd_e2e.rs`). `solution.component.push-tag-policy-surfaces` contains under `solution.container.scanner-cli`.
